critic_terrain_schema.body_semantics: unsigned nearest-surface vector from probe, not signed distance or full-body clearance
critic_terrain_schema.collision: mjlab/MuJoCo Warp static scene geometry; robot excluded
critic_terrain_schema.frame: base position + gravity-aligned Euler yaw; foot/probe positions measured from link origins
critic_terrain_schema.height_semantics: first downward intersection below anchor_z+ceiling; NOT guaranteed support; canopy below ceiling can be selected
critic_terrain_schema.invalid_semantics: valid=False; map heights/normals/points and body vectors/distances zero; missed ray distance=max range
critic_terrain_schema.ray_semantics: first hit, normals oriented against ray; inside/outside not classified
critic_terrain_schema.reset_semantics: foot/body outputs invalid when episode_length_buf==0; root-relative maps remain valid
critic_terrain_schema.units: metres, unit normals; no clipping or normalization
